response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM grp), avgs AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS above_average FROM avgs WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
